graph_metadata.use_case: End-to-end analysis of Python code: validate correctness, generate test cases, and execute them.

graph_description: A three-stage policy graph that takes Python source code as input, validates correctness and suggests optimizations (policy1), generates test inputs and expected outputs using OpenAI (policy2), then executes the test cases against the code and returns all results combined (policy3).

code.description: Python source code string to be analyzed and tested

function_name.description: Name of the function within the code to generate tests for and execute

description.description: Optional human-readable description of what the code does

code_validation.description: Correctness check and optimization suggestions from policy1

issues.description: List of identified bugs or issues

optimized_code.description: Rewritten optimized version of the code

test_inputs.description: Test inputs generated by policy2 (description + kwargs for each case)

test_results.description: Execution results from policy3 (actual vs expected output for each test case)

summary.description: Pass/fail counts across all test cases
